summary.en: Models, metamodels and conformance; why automate with models; the four model-management tasks; a first tour of the Epsilon Playground.
summary.zh: 模型、元模型与符合性；为何借助模型实现自动化；四类模型管理任务；初识 Epsilon Playground。

summary.en: Design a metamodel in Emfatic: classes, attributes, references, containment, opposites, inheritance and enumerations.
summary.zh: 用 Emfatic 设计元模型：类、属性、引用、包含、反向引用、继承与枚举。

summary.en: Write models in Flexmi's XML and YAML flavours, resolve references by name, read conformance warnings and draw model diagrams.
summary.zh: 用 Flexmi 的 XML 与 YAML 写法编写模型，按名称解析引用，读懂符合性警告并生成模型图。

summary.en: Navigate and query models with EOL: collections, first-order operations, operations on types and model changes.
summary.zh: 用 EOL 导航和查询模型：集合、一阶操作、类型上的操作以及修改模型。

summary.en: Express well-formedness rules in EVL with constraints, critiques, guards and fixes.
summary.zh: 用 EVL 表达良构性规则：约束、建议性检查（critique）、守卫条件与修复。

summary.en: Generate Java, HTML and diagrams from models with EGL templates and EGX rules.
summary.zh: 用 EGL 模板和 EGX 规则从模型生成 Java、HTML 和图。

summary.en: Map one metamodel onto another with ETL rules, guards, equivalents and lazy rules.
summary.zh: 用 ETL 规则、守卫条件、equivalent 与惰性规则在元模型之间转换。

title.zh: 模型驱动工程与大语言模型

summary.en: Let a language model draft metamodels and programs, check the drafts with Epsilon, and generate prompts from models.
summary.zh: 让大语言模型起草元模型和程序，用 Epsilon 检查草稿，并从模型生成提示词。

title.zh: 从 Playground 到真实项目

summary.en: Install Eclipse Epsilon, run programs from Ant, Maven and Java, and work with models that are not EMF models.
summary.zh: 安装 Eclipse Epsilon，通过 Ant、Maven 和 Java 运行程序，并处理非 EMF 模型。

summary.en: Build a JHipster-style entity language end to end: metamodel, models, validation, generation and transformation.
summary.zh: 端到端构建一个 JHipster 风格的实体语言：元模型、模型、验证、生成与转换。

en.lead: Learn model-driven engineering by doing it: describe systems as models, define the languages they are written in, and let tools query, check, transform and generate from them. You can run every example from your browser in the Eclipse Epsilon Playground.
study: Each module takes three to four hours. Read a section, then press Open in Playground on its examples. The Epsilon Playground opens with the example loaded, so you can run it, change it and run it again. Nothing needs installing until Module 9.

The output under each example was produced by Eclipse Epsilon 2.8.0 when the page was built. The Playground may run a newer Epsilon, word some messages differently and leave out warnings about the model. Changes you make in the Playground are not saved; use its Download button to keep your work.
Every module ends with exercises with worked solutions and a short self-check quiz. Your progress is saved in this browser and shared by the English and Chinese editions.
acknowledgements: This series draws on Dimitris Kolovos's writing on model-driven engineering, adapted and credited where it is used: Model-Driven Engineering Terminology, Metamodelling with ChatGPT and Minimal JHipster JDL Monolith Example. The examples were written for this series. The running component-and-connector example was inspired by his metamodelling post and by the component example in the Epsilon Playground.

Eclipse Epsilon is an open-source Eclipse Foundation project led from the University of York. Its Playground, hosted at the University of York, makes every example in this series runnable from a browser.

zh.lead: 在实践中学习模型驱动工程：把系统描述为模型，定义编写模型所用的语言，再让工具对模型进行查询、检查、转换和生成。所有示例都可以在浏览器中通过 Eclipse Epsilon Playground 运行。
study: 每个模块需要三到四小时。读完一节后，点击示例上的在 Playground 中打开。Epsilon Playground 会载入该示例，你可以运行、修改并再次运行。第 9 模块之前无需安装任何软件。
每个示例下方的输出由构建页面时的 Eclipse Epsilon 2.8.0 实际运行得到。Playground 可能运行较新的 Epsilon，部分提示措辞会有所不同，并且不显示关于模型的警告。你在 Playground 中的修改不会被保存；如需保留，请使用其 Download 按钮。
每个模块最后都有附参考解答的练习和简短自测。学习进度保存在当前浏览器中，中英文版本共享。
acknowledgements: 本系列借鉴了 Dimitris Kolovos 关于模型驱动工程的文章，并在使用处注明出处：Model-Driven Engineering Terminology、Metamodelling with ChatGPT 和 Minimal JHipster JDL Monolith Example。示例均为本系列编写；贯穿全系列的组件与连接器示例受到他的元建模文章以及 Epsilon Playground 中组件示例的启发。
Eclipse Epsilon 是 Eclipse 基金会的开源项目，由约克大学牵头开发。它的 Playground 由约克大学托管，让本系列的每个示例都能直接从浏览器运行。
